home.title: Find practical help near you
home.eyebrow: Clear information, when you need it
home.description: Browse published activities, read reviewed practical information, or use the private guide to find the closest next step.
home.searchPlaceholder: What do you need? e.g. food, shower, doctor
home.activitiesDescription: Filter services and see exact public locations in a low-data map.
home.urgentBody: The shortest route to the most needed information.
home.openNowBody: Recurring activities run by verified associations. Each card shows the current status and how fresh the information is.
home.servicesBody: Choose a service to see every place that offers it.
home.articlesDescription: Read dated information with a clear factual owner and review status.
home.guideDescription: Answer optional questions one at a time. Your answers are never stored.
home.associationsBody: Every piece of information belongs to a named, verified organisation responsible for keeping it accurate.
home.trust: Accurate, up-to-date information you can rely on
home.trustBody: We choose current over comprehensive. When something is uncertain, we say so.
home.reliabilityDescription: Published records show their owner, review date and uncertainty. Time-sensitive information should still be confirmed with the provider.
home.trustOfflineBody: Answers come first: every page reads without images, without the map and without JavaScript.
home.trustLanguagesBody: Eleven languages, and the five read right to left turn the whole page with them.
home.trustAnonymousBody: Essential public information stays open to everyone, anonymously.
home.metaDescription: Multilingual, verified information about services and practical help in Calais.
